# Step catalogs

Features live in `specs/<domain>/<feature>.feature`. One catalog per package that runs spec domains (its `specDomains` against the sim, its `liveDomains` against a deployment). Spec writers read these and `GLOSSARY.md`; they never read `src/` or `tests/`.
